zh: SLH-DSA：状态无关哈希签名算法的构造名。
stateless：无需跟踪一次性密钥消耗状态。
parameter set：标准批准的具体参数档位。
hash-based：安全性仅建立在哈希原语上。
NIST Special Publication：未来新增参数集的发布载体。
WOTS+/FORS：SLH-DSA 内部的组件签名方案，分别是一次性与少次签名，均不单独批准。
en: SLH-DSA: the stateless hash-based signature construction name.
Stateless: no need to track one-time-key consumption.
Parameter set: a configuration approved by the standard.
Hash-based: security resting only on hash primitives.
NIST Special Publication: the vehicle for future parameter sets.
WOTS+ / FORS: the component schemes inside SLH-DSA — one-time and few-time signing, neither approved stand-alone.
